verdict.rationale: First-party docs say you can start a call with your dot from the phone button in ChatGPT, and type while talking (dots-docs-4). A call reaches the same dot with the same memory as other channels (dots-docs-5), and you can keep talking to it while it works (dots-docs-1, dots-docs-8). This covers the core of a live voice conversation. Missing for 10: no detail on conversational naturalness (latency, interruption/barge-in, voice options), no confirmation of call support on mobile, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of call quality.
